messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Sapphire Retail (acct SAPPH-123) showing ~65% drop in active inference calls over the last 7 days. Renewal ~45 days out. Also seeing an uptick in external hostnames hitting their API keys that look like a competitor eval. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/metrics/account/SAPPH-123

jake_am: Yikes. Have we reached out? Any changes on their side (people/process) we should know about? @maria_cs

maria_cs: Primary internal advocate (Taylor, Head of ML) left last week. Procurement contact replied today mentioning a short trial with a vendor called BlueClip. I DM'd procurement for the email thread.

nora_support: FYI support ticket #4729 — they reported intermittent timeouts on our staging endpoint 3/10 which triggered client-side retries. Might explain inflated client traffic vs successful calls. I flagged it as high.

sam_engineer: Telemetry dump shows new hostnames using SAPPH-123 keys: blueclip-trial.* and blueclip-eval.*. Also seeing a spike in 4xx from a few IP ranges. Quick link: https://internal.redwood/telemetry/SAPPH-123/summary

maria_cs: Quick usage snippet I pulled: 
```sql
SELECT date, active_calls, competitor_calls FROM usage_summary WHERE account = 'SAPPH-123' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 14;
-- results: 2026-03-10: active_calls=1200, competitor_calls=180 | 2026-03-09: active_calls=3500, competitor_calls=20
```

jake_am: Ok — priorities: 1) Immediate outreach to procurement + new contacts; 2) Schedule EBR (showing the delta + migration cost + roadmap); 3) Short-term technical offer (2-week dedicated pilot or discounted dedicated capacity) to lock them in while they evaluate. Can @sam_engineer own a canary config and cost delta proposal?

sam_engineer: I can. Will prepare: a) canary fallback plan (smaller model, reduced token bill) b) cost delta comparison vs. BlueClip trial based on their observed qps. ETA: EOD.

nora_support: I'll surface the timeout root cause and run a perf-run that reproduces their retry pattern, so we can show the stability difference. Will attach results to the EBR docs.

ops-bot: Incident created — #4729 linked to thread 2981123456. Assigned: nora_support, sam_engineer.

maria_cs: Drafting outreach email to procurement & new procurement contact that highlights migration lift, data portability effort, and short-term pilot offer. Will post draft in #customer-comms for review. Also proposing an escalation trigger: if >10% of their traffic is redirected to a competitor for 48+ hours, we flag for AE + exec notify.

jake_am: Good — also check contract SOW v2 for termination windows and early-exit penalties. @legal will need to weigh in but we should prepare playbook.

maria_cs: There is a 30-day termination notice in SOW v2 but procurement sometimes negotiates exceptions. Looping legal off-thread.

nora_support: Follow-up task for EBR: I'll run a 95th-percentile latency sim with their config and compare our canary vs their current setup. Hoping to have numbers before the meeting.

maria_cs: Next steps (summarized): EBR scheduled Thu 3/12 11:00am PT; Sam -> canary & cost delta; Nora -> perf-run & ticket RCA; Jake -> renewal playbook + escalation criteria; I'll send the outreach and prep stakeholder list.

jake_am: Sounds good. Please add meeting invite and include procurement + engineering contacts. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Will do. Updating thread after EBR.
note: thread captures renewal-risk triage for usage drop + stakeholder change + competitor eval; short, action-focused Slack style
